assignments.reason: This node ('one who does complete teshuvah') is an active-voice variant of 'תשובה שלמה' already in Package 1. Its essential nature is the same: the state of wholeness/rest in which evil is fully expelled and the soul achieves נַיְחָא. It is not merely causally connected to Shabbat — it IS the Shabbat-state described in active terms.

new_packages.label: שִׁפְלוּת וַעֲנָוָה
new_packages.reason: Three cause/effect nodes share the essential nature of true humility and self-nullification (אַיִן). שפלות is the quality of seeing one's own lowliness; the compound node about seeing שפלות describes the same inner capacity; the protection-of-livelihood node is the state of being unmovable because one has become אַיִן through humility. This domain is distinct from Package 1 (שבת/תשובה = rest/completeness): Shabbat ENABLES seeing שפלות, but שפלות itself is a separate essential quality — self-nullification rather than rest. The additions file (torah_79_additions.json) independently identified this same cluster.

nodes_assigned.reason: The core concept of this package — true humility, seeing one's own lowliness. The Torah states this is בְּחִינוֹת שְׁבוּ אִישׁ תַּחְתָּיו and that the truly humble person הוּא בִּבְחִינַת אַיִן. Its essential nature is self-nullification.

Despite the textual concatenation with תשובה שלמה, this node's essential nature is the capacity to perceive one's own שפלות — the seeing-faculty applied to humility. It is an expression of the שפלות domain (the ability to truly see one's lowliness), not of the Shabbat/rest domain.

nodes_assigned.node_id: שום אדם לא יוכל להוציאו ממקומו, דהינו לדחותו מפרנסתו
nodes_assigned.reason: This node describes the state of being undisplaceable because one is בִּבְחִינַת אַיִן — truly humble and therefore not 'under any place' at all. Its essential nature is the protective invulnerability that IS the אַיִן-state of humility. It is not a separate domain but a manifestation of the same שפלות/ענוה quality. The Torah links it directly: עַל־יְדֵי שֶׁזּוֹכִין לְשִׁפְלוּת... אַל יֵצֵא אִישׁ מִמְּקוֹמוֹ.

new_packages.label: צַדִּיק וְרָעֲיָא מְהֵימָנָא
new_packages.reason: One cause/effect node describes the compound quality of recognizing Israel's greatness and being able to sacrifice oneself for them — the Moshe/Mashiach/Raya Mehemna dimension. This is essentially the leadership-through-self-sacrifice quality that the Torah identifies as the mark of every true Tzaddik. The additions file (torah_79_additions.json) independently identified 'משיח / משה / צדיק' as a proposed new package with this same essential nature.

nodes_assigned.reason: This compound node's essential nature is the Raya Mehemna quality — the capacity to see both one's own lowliness AND the greatness of Israel, leading to self-sacrifice on their behalf. While it contains a שפלות component, its dominant essence is the faithful-shepherd leadership quality (מוסר נפשו בעד ישראל). The Torah explicitly equates this with the מֹשֶׁה/מָשִׁיחַ dimension: the Tzaddik who knows his smallness and Israel's greatness and therefore gives his life for them.
